"""RFC 7807-style reporting for Meridian CRM legacy validation failures."""

LEGACY_ERROR_CODES = frozenset(
    {
        "E1001",
        "E1002",
        "E1003",
        "E1004",
        "E1005",
        "E2001",
        "E2002",
        "E2003",
        "E2004",
        "E3001",
        "E3002",
        "E3003",
        "E3004",
        "E3005",
        "E3006",
        "E3007",
        "E4001",
        "E4002",
        "E4003",
        "E4004",
        "E5001",
        "E5002",
        "E5003",
        "E5004",
        "E5005",
    }
)


def problem_details(errors: list[dict]) -> dict:
    """Return a validation problem document preserving all failures in order."""
    reported_errors = []
    blocked = False

    for error in errors:
        code = error["code"]
        if code not in LEGACY_ERROR_CODES:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown legacy validation error code: {code!r}")

        severity = error["severity"]
        if severity == "BLOCK":
            blocked = True

        reported_errors.append(
            {
                "code": code,
                "message": error["message"],
                "severity": severity,
            }
        )

    return {
        "type": "https://meridian-crm.example/problems/validation",
        "title": "Legacy validation failed",
        "status": 422 if blocked else 200,
        "blocked": blocked,
        "errors": reported_errors,
    }
